correctness.rationale: For U_{n+2}=P U_{n+1}−U_n, P≠0, v2(P)=h≥2, the standard companion recurrence gives v2(V_{2j})=1, v2(V_{2j+1})=h, and v2(U_{2j})=h+v2(j) for j>0. Same-parity Lucas difference identity then proves index isometries of even, 1 mod4, and 3 mod4 subsequences at scales 2^h, 2^{2h}, 2^{2h}. Each induces a permutation on every Z/2^N, hence its completed image is one whole 2-adic ball; disjointness at precision≥2 produces exact count 2^max(0,N−h)+min(2,2^{N−1})2^max(0,N−2h) and Haar proportion 2^{−h}+2^{1−2h}. The actual verifier script checks entire finite recurrence orbits over 12 signed P parameters and N≤11, but the stated identities prove all P,N.
